story.title: Bayern continue unbeaten start in Kompany's absence
story.summary: Bayern Munich beat Freiburg to return to the top of the Bundesliga, as the German champions paid tribute to absent manager Vincent Kompany who is recovering in hospital after he collapsed while watching Bayern's second team train.
